overloads.semanticRole: The Session info command returns an object describing the session whose ID you pass in the sessionID parameter..

constraints: Returns a null object if sessionId does not identify a valid session.
This command returns the .info property of the sessionId session; to get information about the current session, call Session.info directly instead.
The type property can be remote, storedProcedure, standalone, rest or web.
Remote-session unreachableSince is the number of seconds since the peer became unreachable; on 4D Server it is also readable through Process activity.sessions[].
